description: The inventory view-model (Features WV2, P6.core; catalog items-inventory), moved into core from Babylon: the rows a panel draws (groups, items, every affordance), the filter tabs, folded groups, the derived equipment and the gold, over the currentState.player save slice. Op inventory {player: {gold, inventory}, steps?: [{op: add (item) | remove (item, quantity?) | filter | toggle (group) | set_gold | add_gold | remove_gold (amount; null is NaN) | equip_flag (item, equipped)}]} -> {initial, steps: [{result, state}]}; state is {filter, counts, gold, rows (an item row without its item object), equipment (slot -> id), save}. Every case is {name, op, input, expected}; numbers compare within tolerance, everything else exactly, object key sets included (a key TypeScript leaves undefined is absent). Runner: src/props/props-corpus.ts. Regenerate with npm run props-corpora; npm run props-corpora:check fails on any difference.
sources: babylon origin/main bfcdeb2: packages/babylon/src/engine/game-engine/ui/inventory-model.ts (437 lines), moved with its rules except the four in src/ui/inventory-model.ts's header (pinned order, itemId read, remove below 1 refused, non-finite gold ignored).
godot origin/main 6599874: addons/insimul/ui/inventory_panel.gd reads itemId (the trade model's key).

contract.id: id, else itemId; an entry with neither is skipped; a later entry with a loaded id replaces the earlier; name is name, else itemName, else the id
contract.order: groups: pinnedGroup first, then by name order; items: equipped first, then rarityOrder (none or unknown is common), then name order, then id order. name order: fold ASCII A-Z to a-z only (no Unicode case mapping: É stays U+00C9, İ stays U+0130), compare the folded strings by UTF-16 code unit, then the raw strings by code unit (Babylon used localeCompare, which is locale-dependent)
contract.filter: quest: type quest or key; weapons_armor: type weapon, armor or tool, or category weapons, armor or tools; consumables: type consumable, food or drink, or category consumables, food_drink or alchemy; materials: type material, or category materials or crafting; else other. The category compares ASCII-folded (as in name order). An unknown filter key is ignored
contract.group: category with underscores as spaces and each word capitalised, else the type capitalised, else Other
contract.slot: equipSlot, else weapon -> weapon, armor -> armor, tool with effects -> accessory, else none; a binding equips through EquipmentManager.equip({...item, equipSlot: slot})
contract.row: nameColor: equippedNameColor when equipped, else the rarity colour, else the type colour; canEquip slot and not equipped; canUnequip slot and equipped; canUse type in usableTypes; useLabel Read for type or category document; canDrop not quest and not equipped; borderColor rarity colour + 88 above common, else plainBorder; tagLine rarity above common capitalised, baseType title-cased else type capitalised, material title-cased, joined with ' · '; quantity a finite quantity, else 1
contract.store: add stacks onto a held id (quantity default 1); remove of a quantity not finite or < 1 is refused; otherwise subtracts and drops the entry at <= 0 (removing more than is held returns true); equipment is the first equipped item per slot in insertion order
contract.gold: loads a finite gold, else 0; set clamps at 0; a non-finite amount changes nothing; remove refuses a non-finite, negative or larger amount

cases.name: inventory: an empty pack shows one empty row
inventory: groups (Quest pinned first, then by name), items equipped first, then rarity, then name; every affordance
inventory: each filter tab, and a tab with nothing in it
inventory: a folded group shows its header only; folding again unfolds it
inventory: add stacks onto a held id; a new id appends with quantity 1 by default
inventory: remove takes some, drops the stack at zero or below, and refuses an unknown id or a quantity below 1
inventory: entries keyed itemId (the trade model's key) are read too; one with neither key is skipped
inventory: a second entry with the same id replaces the first on load
inventory: names sort case-folded by code unit, then raw; ties by id
inventory: non-ASCII names fold only A-Z: É, é, İ and i sort by code unit; a category folds the same (WEAPONS is gear, Food_Drİnk is not food_drink)
inventory: rarity order legendary, epic, rare, uncommon, then common, none and unknown together
inventory: equipment derives from equipped items; the first equipped per slot wins
inventory: a tool is equippable only with effects; equipSlot wins over the type
inventory: an equipped quest item cannot be dropped; a document reads Read
inventory: gold: spend refuses short or negative, add and set clamp at 0, non-finite changes nothing
inventory: gold that is not a number loads as 0
inventory: a row with no quantity shows 1; an unknown rarity sorts as common, by name
inventory: the group label is the category title-cased, else the type
inventory: the tag line is rarity above common, base type or type, then material
